<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>We just gotta set up a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)> around here, and
it’ll connect to the island where the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center is!

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Which means I should probably teach you how to make
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)>!

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Well? Go on, <$cdef(27)>! Try makin’ <$cdef(27)>one
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)>,
just
like I
taught ya!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Heyyy, that looks real good! You’ve got talent,

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>All right, try <$voicel(2,8)>placin’ a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)> so it connects to the

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>All right, try placin’ a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1457)> so it connects to the
island where the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center is!
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>I think right around here would be perfect!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Perfect! That spot oughta do the trick!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>Now we’ve got a <$cdef(27)>lift runnin’ between here and the
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center island!

<$voicel(2,5)>Y’know, I’d love to check out the town you’re buildin’.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Why don’t ya escort me to the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Hoho! So you’re the great builder <$cdef(27)>Tinkaton?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I hope you’ll continue helping out our
friend <$cdef(27)>!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Sure thing! Just say the word, and I’ll help build up this
town any way I can!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Now, let me see if there’s anything I can get started on...

If you make <$cdef(27)>lifts, you can have Pokémon follow you even
to far-off places.
If you don’t have enough <$cdef(27)><$ifull(119)> to craft with, give
<$cdef(27)>Tinkaton <$cdef(27)><$ifull(115)> and have them make some!
